scoring_scale: 0-100 per category; 90 means genuinely close visual correspondence. Scores are independent for this pass and do not inherit prior values.

pass_gate.required: Every room must score at least 90 in lighting, art_style and layout_fidelity after iteration.
pass_gate.reason: Briefing is compositionally close but still materially and tonally behind the target; Hall retains poster/equipment crop defects; Locker remains dark and foreground-dominated.

BRIEFING.overall_read: The room now has a broad, legible composition with TV, boards, two benches, console and open entrance. Warmth is improved, but the target has richer plaster/wainscot wear, more balanced amber fill and less regular plant foliage; the left console and right plant still differ in scale and dressing.

HALL.overall_read: The corridor axis and major openings read, with more target equipment visible. The left poster headline is still cropped high, the right extinguisher is oversized and cut at the bottom, the pipe is clipped, and the render's props/materials remain simpler than the target.

LOCKER.overall_read: The pod, two benches, small tile floor, portal and locker banks are present and constraints remain legible. The large foreground locker and pod still crowd the frame, the scene is darker than the target, and the four identical entry lockers are not immediately countable.

Add warm fill to the foreground locker faces and pod recesses; keep the amber ceiling pools and contact shadows but recover the target's visible tile, locker and storage detail from near-black.

Replace the large foreground plant's repeated edge-on leaves with fuller varied foliage, and tune shelf/planter/laundry dressing toward the target's natural, maintained locker-room density without adding suits.

Add matte roughness and restrained wear to small bathroom tiles, locker paint, benches, towels, shelves and labels; reduce the current near-white floor and generic prop read while keeping the room maintained.

limitations: This review compares still renders with target stills whose camera, lens and crop are not numerically calibrated; framing is included in layout fidelity, while recommendations keep architecture fixed.
The target images are ChatGPT-generated. Text, exact poster graphics, portraits and incidental props are style/dressing cues rather than literal geometry requirements.

User constraints outrank accidental target details: preserve four identical lockers near entry in two physical banks, no suits, exactly two briefing benches, a clear pod, open room entrances, matte timber, small bathroom tiles and used-but-maintained materials.
Pass-03 was judged from the three REFERENCE_*.png renders only; no scene script, geometry, contact-check output or passage-ray output was used to increase visual scores.
